titleEn: Law on the establishment of the State Secretariat of Border Affairs

articles.en: The State Secretariat of Border Affairs is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
The State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall have the competence to lead and manage the border affairs of the Kingdom of Cambodia, both land borders and maritime borders.

The State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall be led and managed by one Minister, assisted by Secretaries of State and a number of Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
The Secretaries of State and Under-Secretaries of State shall perform their duties as assigned by the Minister in charge of the State Secretariat of Border Affairs.
- In the exercise of his or her competence, the Minister in charge of the State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall be accountable to the Prime Minister and to the National Assembly.

- The Minister in charge of the State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall have the right to issue prakas, decisions, circulars and instructions in accordance with the Law on the Organisation and Functioning of the Council of Ministers.
The State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall have its own budget package financed by the national budget and shall have civil servants of the establishment and contractual officials in order to carry out its work, in accordance with the laws and legal instruments in force.

._ The organisation and functioning of the State Secretariat of Border Affairs shall be determined by sub-decree.
.- Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

- This Law is declared to be urgent.
